extDescription.message: Send browser downloads, links and page resources to the Fluxer download manager.

sendUnreachable.message: Fluxer is not reachable. Make sure the app is installed.

pageVideoTitle.message: Download the video on this page

pageVideoHint.message: YouTube, Vimeo, X and 1000+ sites — pick the quality in Fluxer.
